name: NIH ChestX-ray14 Database
description: A national hospital-scale medical imaging benchmark consisting of 112,120 frontal-view chest radiographs from 30,805 unique patients treated at the National Institutes of Health Clinical Center between 1992 and 2015. Text-mining tools extracted 14 common thoracic disease categories from associated radiological reports. Safeguard notice: Released as public domain government research data for computer vision benchmarking; not certified or FDA-approved for clinical screening or autonomous diagnostic decisions without physician validation.
